high_level_description: The image shows a close-up of the back of a wristwatch being held by two hands. The watch has a metallic case with a dark blue or black bezel. The back of the watch is engraved with various details: "SÉRIE LIMITÉE" (Limited Series) is written at the top. A logo resembling a stylized airplane is present below the text. The words "ÉTANCHE 100 M" (Waterproof 100 meters) indicate the watch's water resistance. The reference number "B13050.1" is also visible.
